records.question: How is the pathological non-IID MNIST partition constructed in the original FedAvg experiments?

In the original FedAvg MNIST non-IID partition, the training data is sorted by digit label, divided into 200 shards of size 300, and each of 100 clients is assigned 2 shards. [E2]

Before averaging, FedBN keeps each client's batch normalization layers local: BN parameters are not communicated to or aggregated at the server. Only the non-BN layers are updated with FedAvg. [E2] [E3]

In the paper's toy example, local BN makes the clients' local training error surfaces similar, so averaging the models becomes beneficial, whereas averaging without local BN gave a poor model. [E3]
